added: Dances can now be stored in English country dance formations (duple minor, triple minor, a two-couple set, three- to six-couple longways, circle, Sicilian circle and square) and marked improper, and can record the tune's meter and key. Backups, share files and Device Sync carry them. Entering them in the dance editor comes in a later release. An older version of the app can't restore a backup that holds them, and a device on an older version skips a synced dance in one of the new formations, with any program or related dance that names it, until it is updated.

Dance.meter and Dance.musicalKey (schema v42 columns meter and musical_key), Formation.improper (formation_improper), the ECD FormationShape values with offeredFormationShapes(form), and PhraseStructure.beatsForHalfBars for the half-bar rule (ADR-006 §12, F2 and F3; Q16). Archive envelope v8 is stamped when a dance carries any of them.
